summary: Completed comprehensive testing of FilmStrip bug fix for iPhone/mobile 'IN MOVIMENTO' section. Verified that videos mount and play, and marquee auto-scrolls correctly even with prefers-reduced-motion=reduce (iPhone Low Power Mode / Riduci Movimento). All critical functionality working as designed.
passed_tests: MOBILE + REDUCED MOTION: Videos mounted (3 videos), all playing with currentTime advancing, marquee moving automatically (38.27px in 1.4s)
DESKTOP + NO REDUCED MOTION: Videos mounted (7 videos), all playing, marquee moving automatically (45.26px in 1.4s)
TOUCH/POINTER INTERACTION: Marquee slows on press (81% reduction), auto-resumes after release
VIEWPORT BEHAVIOR: Marquee pauses when section out of viewport (0px movement), resumes when back in view (32.33px)
TOGGLE PUBBLICO <-> SEGRETO: Toggle works correctly, video sources change (pub→sec), marquee continues moving after toggle
NO CONSOLE ERRORS: No JavaScript errors detected
data-reduced-motion attribute correctly reflects emulated state (1 when reduce, 0 when no-preference)
Video sources: WebM used in Chromium headless (correct), MP4 H.264 would be used on Safari/iOS (as designed)
requestAnimationFrame marquee engine working independently of CSS animation and prefers-reduced-motion
Transform matrix (m41) measurement confirms automatic movement without user interaction
